gap: No result ChatGPT got states that, at today's prices on qidi3d.com, a QIDI Q2 ($449) plus a QIDI Box ($228) comes to $677. That makes it the cheapest enclosed four-filament setup with active chamber heating (65 °C) that we could price today, $72 below the $749 Creality K2 Pro Combo on Creality's own store. ChatGPT recommended the K2 Pro Combo at $799 for ABS, ASA and nylon.
standout_why: We compared against the cited desktop3dprinters.us multicolor-enclosed list (dated 2026-10-28, opened today). That page already lists the QIDI Q2 as actively heated to 65 °C, with a $499 printer launch price and a $649 Combo launch price. It also lists the K2 Pro at an $849 printer launch price with 60 °C heating. A reader can therefore already work out that the Q2 is the cheaper heated option, from launch prices. What the page lacks is today's prices. It has no current price for the Q2, Q2 Combo or QIDI Box, and none for the K2 Pro Combo, which has fallen to $749 on Creality's store. It also has no current Bambu prices. The other cited result, 3dprinterlist.com, is a spec table. We did not open it. Our angle adds only the current, dated price gap.
decides: It narrows ChatGPT's 'if you need ABS/ASA/nylon' pick. The K2 Pro Combo really costs $749 today on Creality's store, not the $799 ChatGPT showed. Buying the QIDI Q2 and QIDI Box separately costs $677, about $72 less, and gives a 65 °C actively heated chamber against the K2 Pro's 60 °C (both figures from desktop3dprinters.us). The trade-off is volume: 270 × 270 × 256 mm against 300 × 300 × 300 mm. For PLA and PETG multicolor, the two cheapest enclosed combos are the passive-chamber Elegoo Centauri Carbon 2 Combo ($399) and Anycubic Kobra S1 ACE 2 Pro Combo ($499), and both lose for engineering filaments. That also undercuts ChatGPT's 'best value' Bambu P1S Combo at $479.99, but we could not confirm any Bambu price today.
